meta.name: sandbox-migrate-to-next
meta.description: Migrate Cloudflare Sandbox apps from stable @cloudflare/sandbox to @cloudflare/sandbox@next (SDK 1.0 preview). Use sandbox-next for apps already on the preview.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 切换项目依赖到新 SDK 预览版，提前验证新接口
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的项目正用稳定版沙箱 SDK,想提前切换到预览版体验新接口。
copy.tagline_en: Move your Sandbox project to the new preview SDK and verify APIs ahead of time.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use the stable Sandbox SDK and want to test your code against the next preview.

howto.what: 当你要求把 Cloudflare 沙箱应用从稳定版 @cloudflare/sandbox 升到预览版 @cloudflare/sandbox@next 时,它会按官方迁移文档审查规则、扫描代码找出需要改的 API,与你确认生产切换等选择,然后升级依赖、镜像并改写代码,最后逐一验证。
howto.when: 当你说要把现有的 Cloudflare Sandbox 应用从稳定版迁移到 @next(SDK 1.0 预览版)时触发。若应用已在预览版上,它不会接管,而应使用 sandbox-next 技能。

say.text: 把我的 Cloudflare Sandbox 应用从稳定版迁移到 @next
say.note: 会先扫代码、问清切换方式,再动手升级

say.text: 迁移到 @next,先不要切换生产环境
say.note: 会跳过生产部署,只完成代码迁移

say.text: 迁移并验证,把包和镜像都升到 @next 预览版
say.note: 会检查 Worker 包和容器镜像是否同为 @next

howto.what_en: When asked to migrate a Cloudflare Sandbox app from stable @cloudflare/sandbox to @next preview, it reviews official migration rules, audits code for deprecated APIs, clarifies production cutover with you, upgrades the package/image, rewrites code to the new SDK, and runs validation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to migrate an existing Cloudflare Sandbox app from stable to @next (SDK 1.0 preview). It will not take over if the app is already on the preview — that's sandbox-next's job.

say_en.text: Migrate my Cloudflare Sandbox app from stable to @next
say_en.note: It audits the code, clarifies rollout, then upgrades.

say_en.text: Migrate to @next but don't switch production yet
say_en.note: It will do the code migration but skip the production deploy.

say_en.text: Migrate and validate — upgrade both the package and image to @next preview
say_en.note: It checks the Worker package and container image match @next.
